strengths.item: The paper is generally readable and well organized in a standard ICLR-style format, with clear section headings, consistent margins, readable body text, and page numbers.
The method and experiments are structured coherently: motivation, related work, probabilistic formulation, losses, datasets, baselines, ablations, and results are presented in a logical order.
Equations on pages 3–5 are generally well formatted and numbered, with no obvious margin overflow or broken layout.
Tables 1–2 on page 7 are compact, aligned, and legible, with captions that clearly state the metrics and datasets.
Figure and table captions are generally informative and help connect the visual evidence to the claims.

weaknesses.item: Several figures are difficult to inspect at page scale. Figure 1 on page 2 contains many small internal labels, arrows, and mathematical symbols that require zooming.
Figure 2 on page 7 is useful but has small subpanel labels, colorbars, and fine pixel-level details, making visual verification harder.
Figures 3–4 on page 8 are too small for comfortable inspection; axis labels, legends, tick labels, and markers are difficult to read without zooming.
The text is sometimes visually dense, especially in the abstract, long captions, and math-heavy method sections.
Table 3 on page 8 is mostly readable but dense, with many vertical rules and a tight side-by-side MNIST/Cityscapes layout.

dimension_review.evidence_summary: The PDF inspection found a generally clean ICLR-style layout with readable text, clear headings, and well formatted equations. Tables are mostly legible and captions are informative. The main presentation issues are visual: Figure 1, Figure 2, and especially Figures 3–4 contain small text, labels, legends, or fine details that require zooming. Page 8 is comparatively dense due to multiple plots and Table 3. No major broken floats, margin overflows, or severe formatting problems were observed.
dimension_review.rationale: The paper is understandable and organized well enough for reviewers to follow the method and experiments, and most tables and equations are inspectable. However, several important figures are visually cramped or difficult to read at normal page scale, and some sections are dense due to long paragraphs, heavy notation, and lengthy captions. These are notable but not severe issues, so the appropriate Presentation score is 3: good presentation with minor-to-moderate clarity and formatting issues.
